description.narrative: 1.The Tripartite Negotiating Forum (TNF) has been reformed with the enactment of the TNF Act in 2019 providing a legal framework for the establishment of a substantive SECRETARIAT to support tripartite social dialogue processes: a. In January 2020, the TNF resumed meetings at the Technical Committee and Principals levels and agreed on agenda to address broader economic, social and labour market governance issues representing the three (3) chambers under the TNF. b. In December 2020, tripartite partners have developed a roadmap for the operationalization of the new law. A Tripartite Technical Committee has been established and spearheaded the drafting of the protocols and standard operating procedures for the TNF. An organogram and the terms of references for the SECTRATARIAT have also developed. c. In line with the TNF Act and agreement of the principals, the Government allocated resources under the 2020 and 2021 national budget. d. The Tripartite Technical Committee developed a position paper on the role of dialogue in ensuring inclusive and sustainable economic growth, employment and decent work that was used inputs into the National Development Strategy 1 finalisation. 1a. The ILO has been engaging Tripartite Partners in Zimbabwe in capacity development support to strengthen social dialogue and observance of international labour standards as part of the follow-up to conclusions and recommendations of ILO Supervisory Bodies. In 2020-2021, the ILO through Regular Budgetary Supplementary Account funding provided financial support for the recruitment of an international expert who provided international best practices and facilitated negotiations by the Tripartite Technical Committee that drafted the protocols and procedures. 1b. In June 2020 the TNF Technical Committee was supported financially to recruit a team of consultants to draft the position paper. ILO experts provide technical inputs on the finalisation of the paper. In May 2020, the ILO provided ICT equipment and internet connectivity in addition to technical advisory support through sharing information on and from COVID-19: ILO Monitor and adapted ILS and Covid-19 guidelines.
